title: Speed Limits
grade_or_penalty: Motor vehicle violation; points: 1-14 mph over = 2, 15-29 mph over = 4, 30+ mph over = 5. Fines doubled in safe corridors and construction zones
key_points: Sets statutory speed limits (25 mph school and business districts, 35 mph suburban, 50 mph other locations, 55/65 mph highways as posted).
